My mother-in-law suffered a fall on 3rd March. We called the clinic around 8:00 PM, and the receptionist was extremely helpful in arranging an immediate consultation with Dr. Kunal Shah.

I am sharing these experiences after several months because I wanted to describe the complete treatment journey and the final outcomes.

The clinic follows a first-come, first-served system, so waiting times can sometimes be an hour or two. However, I would sincerely advise patients to be patient because you are in very capable hands.

*THE 10-SECOND SCOLIOSIS CHECK*
*Could Your Child Have a Curved Spine?*

Many children with scoliosis have *no pain at all*, which is why it often goes unnoticed until the curve becomes more obvious.

✅ One shoulder higher than the other

Many runners have excellent cardiovascular fitness and endurance, but running alone may not fully protect against age-related muscle loss (sarcopenia), reduced strength, or declining bone health.

✅ Prevention of age-related muscle loss

Do you spend several hours daily looking at your phone, laptop, or tablet?

As the head tilts forward, the load on the neck muscles and cervical discs increases significantly, contributing to neck pain, shoulder stiffness, headaches, poor posture, and upper back discomfort.

A simple habit can help:
✅ Hold your phone closer to eye level
✅ Avoid prolonged neck flexion
✅ Take movement breaks every 20–30 minutes
✅ Perform gentle neck and upper back stretches regularly
